label: Android Texter
description: Send SMS and MMS through Android phones; manage messages, contacts, quick replies, spam and webhooks

operations.name: send_message
operations.description: Queues a message through a linked Android phone. A successful response confirms queueing, not delivery. Optional scheduling uses an ISO 8601 timestamp.

operations.name: send_broadcast
operations.description: Sends the same SMS or MMS to up to 500 recipients. Inspect each result and the failed count; HTTP success can include failed recipients.

operations.name: archive_conversation
operations.description: Incoming messages automatically unarchive the conversation.

operations.name: delete_conversation
operations.description: Deletes all conversation messages and tells every linked phone to delete its copy. Cannot be reversed; repeating the delete returns 404.

operations.name: upsert_contact
operations.description: Upserts by phone number and merges tags with existing tags.

operations.name: flag_spam
operations.description: Hides the conversation and suppresses notifications. If default_spam_live_mode is enabled on the account, also starts its AI evidence-collection agent; engaged in the response reports this.

operations.name: unflag_spam
operations.description: Leaves any active AI engagement on the phone as-is.

operations.name: create_webhook
operations.description: The response includes a signing secret shown only once. Store it to verify incoming delivery signatures. This action registers a subscription; it does not create a NoClick trigger.
